factual_claims.claim: Impero delivered resilient growth in 2025 despite geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainty that weakened customer decision-making and sales activity in the first half.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO letter states '2025 was a year defined by geopolitical uncertainty, economic volatility... Despite headwinds, our company delivered resilient performance... we regained momentum in the second half of the year... delivered our best second half ever in terms of net new ARR.' Management commentary confirms 'We regained momentum in the second half of the year... following a difficult start to the year due to heightened geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainty.'

candidate_sentences.text: Impero delivered resilient growth in 2025 despite geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainty that weakened customer decision-making and sales activity in the first half.

factual_claims.claim: Other external expenses and staff costs each increased 6%, reflecting continued investment in commercial activities, lead generation, new hires, salary adjustments, and commercial organizational changes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'Other external expenses increased by 6% compared to 2024... primarily a result of our continued commitment to invest in commercial activities, including costs for lead generation activities through an agency.' and 'Staff costs increased by 6% in 2025 compared to 2024... primarily related to new hirings and salary adjustments, while organizational adjustments in the Commercial team also had an impact.' Management commentary mentions 'balanced our cost level' and 'adjusted our commercial organization' with new CCO appointment.

candidate_sentences.text: Other external expenses and staff costs each increased 6%, reflecting continued investment in commercial activities, lead generation, new hires, salary adjustments, and commercial organizational changes.

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'Impero's operating profit amounted to negative DKK 6.8M in 2025, which is an improvement of DKK 4.6M from negative DKK 11.4M in 2024' and 'EBITDA amounted to negative DKK 3.1M in 2025 which is an improvement of DKK 5.6M from negative DKK 8.7M in 2024.' Strategy update confirms 'significant improvement in EBITDA and lowered cash burn.'

candidate_sentences.text: Profitability improved materially.

factual_claims.claim: The improvement was supported by revenue growth outpacing increases in staff and external expenses, as well as DKK 5.2M of capitalized development costs, up from DKK 3.6M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states 'revenue increase of 19% compared to the lower increase in staff costs and other external expenses of 6%' and 'Activation of development costs of DKK 5.2M in 2025... This is an increase from DKK 3.6M in 2024 due to increased focus on developing new features.' Income statement notes show 'Own work capitalized' of 5,190 DKK T in 2025 vs 3,621 DKK T in 2024.

candidate_sentences.text: The improvement was supported by revenue growth outpacing increases in staff and external expenses, as well as DKK 5.2M of capitalized development costs, up from DKK 3.6M.

factual_claims.claim: Development investment remained substantial as the company expanded its platform and launched the Control Testing module and initial AI capabilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary states 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module, advancing our AI agenda from exploration to live implementation... Our development cycles and process have matured... allowing us to deliver more impactful features more consistently.' Product milestones section details Control Testing launch and AI initiatives.

candidate_sentences.text: Development investment remained substantial as the company expanded its platform and launched the Control Testing module and initial AI capabilities.

factual_claims.claim: Year-end ARR reached DKK 46.2M, up 19% from DKK 38.7M and at the upper end of the revised guidance range.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state 'At the end of 2025, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to a 19% year-on-year growth rate... in line with Company Announcement No. 19-2025.' Management commentary confirms 'At the end of 2025, Impero's ARR amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to an increase of 19% compared to the end of 2024 and in line with our preliminary released 2025 ARR.'

candidate_sentences.text: Year-end ARR reached DKK 46.2M, up 19% from DKK 38.7M and at the upper end of the revised guidance range.

factual_claims.claim: Momentum recovered in the second half, with fourth-quarter net new ARR of DKK 3.1M versus DKK 1.8M in the fourth quarter of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'We ended the year with a strong Q4 2025, with net new ARR of DKK 3.1M, compared to DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter in 2024.' Management commentary mentions 'improved market conditions in the second half... we delivered our best second half ever in terms of net new ARR.'

candidate_sentences.text: Momentum recovered in the second half, with fourth-quarter net new ARR of DKK 3.1M versus DKK 1.8M in the fourth quarter of 2024.

factual_claims.claim: However, full-year net new ARR declined to DKK 7.5M from DKK 8.3M, reflecting the difficult first half and delayed customer decisions through partners.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development states 'For the full year 2025, Impero's net new ARR was DKK 7.5M compared to net new ARR of DKK 8.3M in the full year 2024.' Management commentary explains 'after a net new ARR increase of only DKK 2M in the first half of 2025 following market headwinds' and 'In 2025, our partners experienced delay in decision making from their customers, which dampened our partner sales in 2025.'

candidate_sentences.text: However, full-year net new ARR declined to DKK 7.5M from DKK 8.3M, reflecting the difficult first half and delayed customer decisions through partners.

candidate_sentences.text: Existing-customer performance remained strong: gross uplift was 12%, churn fell to 1% from 2%, and ARPA increased 8% to DKK 228T.

candidate_sentences.text: NRR decreased modestly to 106% from 108%, partly because DKK 1.8M of customer contraction included approximately DKK 1.0M from recurring service agreements.

candidate_sentences.text: Growth was led by the DACH region, where ARR grew 26%, and Denmark, where net new ARR grew 22%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero surpassed 200 customers by end-2025, with customer base diversification (40% of Danish C25 index and 22.5% of German DAX index) and reduced top-10 customer concentration to 20% of ARR.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... total customer coverage is 40% of the C25 index and 22.5% of the DAX index... top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025'.

candidate_sentences.text: The customer base exceeded 200 customers after 26 additions, while top-10 customer concentration declined to 20% from 24%, strengthening revenue diversification.

verified_key_information_units.information: Growth was driven primarily by Denmark (22% YoY net new ARR growth) and DACH region (26% YoY growth, 44% of total ARR), with strategic expansion planned for UK, Nordics, and Benelux markets.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In Denmark... 22% YoY... DACH region... 26% growth YoY... ARR from other markets declined to DKK 5.5M... strategic focus to expand... UK as well as Benelux'. Management commentary details regional performance and expansion plans.

candidate_sentences.text: Growth was led by the DACH region, where ARR grew 26%, and Denmark, where net new ARR grew 22%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key product milestones included launch of Control Testing module, AI-augmented engineering adoption, and initiation of Entity Management development planned for 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module in July 2025... advancing our AI agenda... Entity Management – supporting segmentation across global enterprises... delivery planned for 2026'. Product milestones section details features and AI integration.

candidate_sentences.text: Development investment remained substantial as the company expanded its platform and launched the Control Testing module and initial AI capabilities.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero raised DKK 15M via directed issue in December 2025, ending 2025 with DKK 18.9M cash; the Board deferred the ambition for recurring cash flow positivity before end-2026 to fund growth investments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Equity and capital: 'raised DKK 15M in a private placement in December 2025... equity stood at DKK 15.4M... cash position of DKK 18.9M'. Strategy update: 'Board of Directors believes that growth investments will create more long-term value than pursuing cash flow positivity before end of 2026... deferred its ambition... as announced in Company Announcement No. 3-2026'.

candidate_sentences.text: Cash ended at DKK 18.9M after a DKK 15M directed issue in December.
With the stronger capital position, Impero decided to accelerate commercial investment and defer its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Board accelerated commercial investments for 2026 (including new hires) to increase ARR growth, expecting ARR of DKK 53-57M (+15-23% YoY) but EBITDA of DKK -2M to -1M due to higher costs.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026: 'Impero expects ARR to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... ARR growth rate of approx. 15% to 23%... EBITDA expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to -1M... new planned hires across commercial organization will increase cost base'. Strategy update details investment plans.

candidate_sentences.text: With the stronger capital position, Impero decided to accelerate commercial investment and defer its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026.
It guides for 2026 ARR of DKK 53–57M and EBITDA between negative DKK 2M and positive DKK 1M.

verified_key_information_units.information: Expansion of partner network in DACH region to five revenue-generating partners complemented own channel, which generated 71% of new ARR in 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'expanded our partner network in Germany... five revenue generating partners in the DACH region... working with several certified consultancies across the German speaking markets, including the four leading global auditing networks (Big4)... own channel led new ARR generation in 2025... new ARR from own channels constituted 71% of total new ARR... partners experienced delay in decision making from their customers, which dampened our partner sales in 2025'. Channel Split section confirms partner vs own channel contribution.

details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K7) are fully represented in the candidate summary with supporting evidence in the trace sentences. K8 (MEDIUM importance) is missing entirely as there is no mention of partner network expansion in DACH or the 71% new ARR from own channel. However, since K8 is of MEDIUM importance and all HIGH criteria are fully covered, the overall coverage is assessed as 'Yes' (score 4).

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S5 states 'Profitability improved materially,' but S6 and S7 show continued losses (EBITDA and net loss), creating a logical gap. The summary does not explain how 'material' profitability improvement is reconciled with ongoing losses.

candidate_sentences.text: Profitability improved materially.
EBITDA was a loss of DKK 3.1M, compared with a loss of DKK 8.7M in 2024, while EBIT improved to a loss of DKK 6.7M from DKK 11.7M.
The net loss was DKK 6.8M, compared with DKK 11.4M the previous year.

coherence_issues.description: S14 mentions 'customer contraction' affecting NRR, while S17 attributes Other-market ARR decline to 'UK contraction.' The summary does not clarify whether these contractions are related or distinct phenomena, creating a logical gap in the explanation of performance drivers.

candidate_sentences.text: NRR decreased modestly to 106% from 108%, partly because DKK 1.8M of customer contraction included approximately DKK 1.0M from recurring service agreements.
Other-market ARR declined 6%, primarily because of UK contraction.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative structure covering revenue, margins, profitability, ARR growth, regional performance, and cash flow. However, there are two notable logical gaps: 1) The claim of 'material' profitability improvement (S5) conflicts with continued losses in EBITDA and net profit (S6-S7) without explanation, creating an unresolved tension. 2) The contraction references in S14 (customer) and S17 (UK market) are presented without clarifying their relationship, leaving an ambiguity in performance attribution. These gaps prevent full internal logical coherence despite strong overall organization and absence of self-contradictions.
